decisions.reason: The accepted use of blurbs and quotes to break up long text does not alter author names, photos, sizing, shape, coverage, or photo source.
The source accepts a text-pacing technique but does not change the magazine's brand alignment, general visual style, or red-color restrictions.
Using blurbs and quotes to interrupt long text does not change the requirement to enhance image quality when needed.
The accepted article-layout approach does not change the required digital flipbook PDF deliverable.
The source does not change the digital launch target or its July 25 deadline.
